plot: The morning after Luna leaves Grandma has a cold and cannot sleep; Max, Dog and Mouse's breakfast-in-bed tray ends in a noisy crash, then even total silence does not help, until Dog says sick friends want someone close, and Max realises Grandma found the house too quiet and almost slept when he purred, so he curls up on her lap and purrs her to sleep; next day she is well and plans to bake an apple pie with Dog as taste tester.

beats.say: Max! Max! Morning! Catch my ball! Woof! Woof!
Shhh! Dog! Stop! Grandma is sick on the sofa!
Can we be quiet for one whole day? Can we?
It's the morning after Luna went home. Grandma caught a cold.
Just a little cold, dears. Achoo! I only need some rest.
Max hops up next to Grandma. She pats his head. Pat, pat.
Max purrs a tiny bit. Grandma's eyes start to close.
Mmm. The house is so quiet without Luna. Too quiet.
Don't worry, Grandma. We'll take care of you! Wait here!
And Max hops off the sofa. Grandma's eyes open again.
What's happening? Why is everyone whispering so loudly?
Grandma has a cold. We have to help her get better fast.
When people are sick, they eat breakfast in bed! On a tray!
Breakfast in bed! Yes! The best breakfast ever!
Max finds a blue tray. Mouse brings a little white cake.
And a banana! Bananas make everyone feel better!
And my yellow ball! Balls make me feel better!
Okay. Very slowly now. Tiptoe, tiptoe. Don't drop anything.
Max carries the tray. Mouse walks ahead. Dog follows with his ball.
Tiptoe. Tiptoe. Then Dog's ball rolls under Max's paws.
Wobble, wobble... CRASH! The tray, the cake, and the banana. Everywhere!
Oh my! Achoo! What was that noise? Is everyone okay?
Sorry, Grandma! We were making you breakfast. A quiet breakfast.
That's very sweet. Achoo! I'll try to sleep again now.
We made it worse. Now she's awake and coughing.
If Grandma doesn't rest, she won't get better. Not today.
Okay. New rule. No noise. Not one sound. Not even a sneeze.
Dog puts down his ball. Very, very quietly.
Mouse cleans up every crumb. Max hides the tray. Not one sound.
The room is so quiet now, you can hear the clock tick.
Then... grrrumble. A very loud tummy. Everyone looks at Dog.
Sorry! My tummy didn't hear the rule. It missed breakfast.
Shhh, tummy! Grandma is resting! Be a good tummy!
But Grandma doesn't sleep. She turns left. She turns right.
It's quiet now. Super quiet. Why can't she sleep?
Maybe she needs a nice song? I know a very short one.
No songs! No noise! You heard the rule!
Max. Can I tell you something? It's my best thinking ever.
When I'm sick, I don't want balls. Or bananas. Or trays.
I want someone close to me. That's all. Just close.
Close? But we want her to sleep. We need quiet!
Quiet isn't the same as alone, Max. Grandma said it's too quiet.
Too quiet without Luna. And she almost slept when I purred!
It's not the noise. Grandma needs me close. And purring!
A purr? That's a sound! You said no sounds!
Purring is a different kind of sound. It's a cuddle sound.
Max tiptoes back to the sofa. He curls up on Grandma's lap.
Prrrr. Prrrr. Max purrs his softest, warmest purr.
Grandma smiles. Her eyes close. In ten seconds, she is asleep.
It worked! Oops. I mean... it worked.
Shhh, Dog. Whisper your happy. Like this. Yay.
The quietest helper was the purring one. Who knew?
Dog lies down by the sofa. Mouse curls up near Grandma's feet.
Nobody makes a big noise. But nobody is far away, either.
All afternoon, Grandma sleeps. And Max purrs and purrs.
The next morning, the sun is bright. Grandma stretches.
Good morning, my dears! I feel so much, much better today!
No more achoo? Not even a teeny tiny one?
Not one. Thanks to the best little nurse cat in town!
And the best thinking dog! I had the idea, remember?
You did, Dog. Your best thinking ever. I'm proud of you.
Taking care of someone doesn't have to be big.
Sometimes it's just staying close. And a little purr.
Now, tomorrow we bake my famous apple pie. Together!
Can I be the taste tester? Please, please, please?
Uh-oh. Who's going to stop Dog from eating the whole pie?

long.title: Shhh! Grandma Is Sick and Max Must Help 🤫🤧🐱

"I wanted to help Grandma... so why did I make it worse?" 🐱
